name: EMA 105 setup on every F&O stock
setup: EMA 105 + ADX>20 + Supertrend + Daily>EMA50 · TOP exit RSI 68

nifty_reference.label: EMA 105 + ADX>20 + Supertrend + Daily>EMA50 | exit: rsi 68 | long only

rules: BUY: a 2-hour candle closes above EMA 105 with ADX(14) > 20, Supertrend(10,3) up and yesterday's daily close above the daily EMA 50.
TOP: RSI(14) reaches 68 and then falls 5 points - sell. Buy again only when price is back within 1 ATR of EMA 105.
EXIT: a 2-hour candle closes below EMA 105.
Long only. 0.035% of price is taken off every trade. Points are rupees per share.

states.BUY: All four checks passed at the latest 2-hour close: new buy.
states.TOP: RSI turned down from above 68 at the latest close: sell / book the gain.
states.HOLD: In a trade from an earlier BUY.
states.EXIT: Closed below EMA 105 at the latest close: sell.
states.WAIT: Above EMA 105 but a check fails, or waiting for a pull-back after a TOP.

limits: The setup was chosen on the Nifty 50 index. Each stock here is an independent test of it, not a re-fit.
About 2 years of 2-hour candles (Yahoo's hourly limit). The unseen third holds only a few trades per stock.
Stock prices, not futures. Gaps, results days and circuit limits are inside the candles.
Paper research. Not SEBI-registered advice. No orders are placed by this website.
